pre-batch: Training Center geo-tagged and verified on SID
Trainer mapped to job role on SID
Scheme eligibility confirmed (PMKVY / SSDM / DDU-GKY / NULM)
Batch created on SID (any error blocks payment)
District Skill Committee contacted / comfort note obtained
mobilize: All learner details uploaded and verified on SID
Portal enrollment completed for each candidate
delivery: Aadhaar-linked biometric synced to SID daily
Skill India branding visible in all class photos
assessment: Third-party assessment agency engaged via SSC/NSDC
closure: SID portal attendance matches physical register
livelihood: Tranche-3: livelihood evidence uploaded to portal
